attributes.action: Call for a new general election in the United Kingdom
attributes.additional_details: Everyone in the UK once change a new general election needs to happen and with someone that knows what they’re doing that’s willing to give everything to this country hopefully get labour party out if everyone signs this petition
attributes.background: I want change in this country and much more to happen. We need a new prime minister to sort this country out.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

General election now – and always call one if a PM is replaced
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771833
